status_detail: North Mankato says the Industrial AUAR was initiated/funded by Project Deacon for possible technology park or office/warehouse uses, but no data-center proposal, plan, or application was ever submitted and no data center is currently planned. MCEA says internal documents suggested data-center intent, but it dismissed its lawsuit after the city said two companies considered a data center and neither moved forward.

project_name: Geronimo Power Nobles County Powered Data Park
status_detail: Nobles County Planning and Zoning Commission recommended no zoning ordinance change for data centers in Agricultural Preservation areas on Feb. 4, 2026; MPR reported the County Board voted April 21, 2026 against the zoning change, preventing massive data centers including Geronimo's $4B proposal.
notes: Geronimo/source and impact study identify Nobles County Data Center/Powered Data Park; DCD/Baxtel/news describe an eight-building, roughly 2.5M sq ft proposal on a 959-acre site between 200th and 190th streets, near Reading. Capacity varies in reporting from 400 MW to 400-500 MW; recorded 400 MW conservatively.
